# Stand Firm in the Gap
## Scripture
"Watch, stand fast in the faith, be brave, be strong." – 1 Corinthians 16:13

## Reflection
Paul’s final words to the Corinthians read like a battle cry. He doesn't tell them to be comfortable, popular, or successful. He tells them to watch—to stay alert to the enemy's schemes. He tells them to stand fast, to plant their feet on the solid ground of the Gospel and refuse to budge. Then he commands them to be brave and strong.

Brother, you are called to stand in the gap for your family, your church, and your community. There is a reason Paul frames this as a fight: the world, the flesh, and the devil will push back against your faith. Your strength isn't found in your own willpower—it's found in your position. You stand *in the faith*. When you feel weak, remember that your footing is not your own effort but Christ's finished work.

Today, you don't need to be the loudest man in the room. You need to be the most anchored. Watch for temptation. Stand fast on truth. Let your courage be a quiet confidence in a God who never fails.

## Daily Challenge
Do 30 pushups today. On each rep, whisper, "I stand fast in the faith." Let your muscles remind you that your spirit is anchored in Christ.
